_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 75.7% bottom analog is compelling context but capital flows are not confirming a transition — ETF flows at 0 and stablecoin growth at -15 mean the fuel tank is empty, so the statistically honest call is to hold position and wait for the coil to resolve.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst explicitly calls HOLD with medium conviction citing lack of fuel; narrative implies directional resolution is imminent. Split is on timing of breakout, not on the bottom analog itself.
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows spike above 40 AND stablecoin growth turns positive while BTC momentum holds above 45
next_move.invalidated_if: ETF flows remain below 10 AND VIX spikes above 80 with funding dropping below 30, pushing score toward Anxiety
